CustomObject.description: What's built lock (build 31). Org default row: whether the What's built tab needs a password, the salted SHA-256 hash of that password (never the password) and who changed it last. User rows: wrong tries, the 15-minute lock-out after 5 wrong tries and how long the user's unlock lasts. Read and written only by RlyBuildLock.
CustomObject.label: RLY Lock
